newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian stocks up led by supermarket chain.
newsitem.headline: Colombian stocks up led by supermarket chain.

text.p: Colombian stocks closed slightly up Thursday led by a pocket-to-pocket deal in the supermarket chain Cadenalco.
Bogota's IBB index edged up 0.04 percent to 842.42 amid a 1.27 billion peso volume while Medellin's IBOMED general price index was up 0.18 percent to 13,387.43 in a 7.8 billion trade.

The highlight on the Medellin exchange was the cross-deal in Cadenalco, which gained 4.32 percent, ending at 845 pesos amid a 4.4 billion peso volume. Chocolate manufacturer Nacional de Chocolates edged up 0.11 percent at 8,376 and cement manufacturer Cemento Argos was up 0.11 percent to 5,266.
